scanNote:
3-MODUL MUQOVASINING O'NG BETI. Bet raqami bosilmagan.

Yuqorida o'ngda katta to'q yashil 'Module' va to'q sariq katakda '3', ostida 'Units 9-12'. Chapdan yashil nuqtali chiziq keladi.

TO'Q SARIQ oval fonda ikki ro'yxat:
'Learn how to ...' • ask for information • agree positively & negatively • suggest solutions to problems • ask for & make suggestions
'Practise ...' • the passive • too/enough • the imperative • might/could/have to/had to/must(n't) • can/be allowed to • conditionals type 2 • relatives • some/any/no

11-UNIT: qizil bo'rtma harflar 'Our Precious Planet'; nuqtali chiziq qizil oval 'Unit 11' ga tushadi. SURATLAR: quvurdan daryoga iflos suv oqmoqda; gazeta-qog'oz uyumi (chiqindi). Ro'yxat: • the environment • pollution • the rainforest • endangered species

12-UNIT: ko'k bo'rtma harflar 'Holidays with a Difference'; nuqtali chiziq ko'k oval 'Unit 12' ga tushadi. SURATLAR: qizil g'ishtli mehmonxona va soyabonli kafe; qor bilan qoplangan uy va qorda yurgan odam. Ro'yxat: • holiday resorts • activities • the weather • jobs

exercises.explanationUz:
3-MODUL MUQOVASI - 11 va 12-UNITLAR
VA MODUL MAQSADLARI.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  LEARN HOW TO (muloqot)          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  • ma'lumot so'rash
  • ijobiy va salbiy rozi bo'lish
    ('So do I' / 'Neither do I')
  • muammolarga yechim taklif qilish
  • taklif so'rash va taklif qilish


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  PRACTISE (grammatika)           ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  • MAJHUL NISBAT (the passive) -
    'The bridge WAS BUILT in 1894.'
  • too/enough - 'too hot', 'hot
    enough'
  • BUYRUQ MAYLI (the imperative) -
    'Don't touch!'
  • might/could/have to/had to/
    must(n't) - modal fe'llar
  • can/be allowed to - ruxsat
  • 2-TUR ShART GAPLARI - 'If I were
    you, I would ...'
  • NISBIY OLMOShLAR (relatives) -
    who, which, that, where
  • some/any/no


⚠ 'OUR PRECIOUS PLANET':

  = bizning qimmatli sayyoramiz.
  ⚠ 'precious' = qimmatli, aziz.
  ⚠ 11-unit - ekologiya.


⚠ 'HOLIDAYS WITH A DIFFERENCE':

  = o'zgacha ta'tillar (odatdagidan
  farqli).
  ⚠ 'with a difference' = o'zgacha,
  g'ayrioddiy.


⚠ 'ENDANGERED SPECIES':

  = yo'qolib ketish xavfi ostidagi
  turlar.
  ⚠ 'species' - birlik va ko'plik
  BIR XIL.
  ⚠ O'qilishi /ˈspiːʃiːz/.


⚠ 'THE RAINFOREST':

  = tropik o'rmon.


⚠ 'POLLUTION':

  = ifloslanish.
  ⚠ 'to pollute' = ifloslantirmoq.


⚠ 'A HOLIDAY RESORT':

  = dam olish maskani, kurort.
